title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 090
review_goal: Differentiate table and tag variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Square table grid with one middle divider and two horizontal dividers making six cells
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a simple six cell table split into two columns and three rows.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the mixed panel table or the nine cell table when the grid should not add a third column.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot is the table with only two columns rather than the uneven panel layout or the full three column grid.

items.depicts_observation: Square table grid with one narrow left column and one full width top row and one large lower right panel
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the table to mix one left side column with one large block on the lower right.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the even six cell table or the even nine cell table when the layout should not feature one oversized lower panel.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot is the only table variant with the uneven left column and large lower right panel.

items.depicts_observation: Square table grid with two vertical dividers and two horizontal dividers making nine cells
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the fullest even table grid with three columns and three rows.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the six cell table or the uneven panel table when the layout should stay a uniform nine cell grid.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot expands the table into an even three by three grid rather than two columns or a mixed panel arrangement.

items.depicts_observation: Price tag shape with one corner hole and one single outline around the body
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the cleanest price tag silhouette with only one visible outline.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the doubled tag when a second offset outline should appear behind the front tag body.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows only one tag outline rather than the stacked double tag effect of the second variant.

items.depicts_observation: Price tag shape with one corner hole and one second offset tag outline behind it
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the tag to read as stacked labels instead of a single front tag.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the single tag when the mark should not show a second offset outline behind the front shape.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot adds a second trailing tag outline that clearly separates it from the single tag variant.
